notes.drawing: The request's picture in Phosphor's parts: arrows-vertical's double arrow (32-unit heads) from 40 to 216, and three of text-indent's lines (y 64, 128, 192), starting at x 120 so the heads keep 16 units clear of them. The arrow runs past the first and last line, so it measures the lines rather than lists them.
notes.fill: As arrows-vertical-fill: the heads become solid triangles.
notes.duotone: Tints the block of lines, as text-indent-duotone does.
